say:4:1210613002:1.text: I'm going to survive, thanks to you all.

say:5:1210613003:1.text: And thank you for driving away the Water Wights.
say:5:1210613003:1.source_cn: 好心人，谢谢你们帮我们赶走水鬼。

say:6:1210613004:1.text: Helping others is an Acorn Knight's duty! Sir Chippy humbly accepts your gratitude!
say:6:1210613004:1.source_cn: 乐于助人是骑士的职责。仓鼠骑士满满，接下您的感谢。

say:7:1210613005:1.text: *Giggle* A knight? Sinbad sure has made some interesting friends.
say:7:1210613005:1.source_cn: 呵呵……骑士？辛巴达居然交到了这么了不得的朋友。

say:8:1210613006:0.text: Um... We're not Sinbad's friends! We just... couldn't abandon people in need.
say:8:1210613006:0.source_cn: 等等，我们不是辛巴达的朋友，我们只是……只是不能见死不救。

say:9:1210613007:1.text: Not friends? Then what did that kid offer you in exchange?

choice_prompt:10:1210613007.text: Not friends? Then what did that kid offer you in exchange?

say:11:1210613008:1.text: True, but seriously, what else can he offer in return? We're so destitute we can't even afford bread, and we're constantly disturbed by the Wights...

choice_prompt:12:1210613008.text: True, but seriously, what else can he offer in return? We're so destitute we can't even afford bread, and we're constantly disturbed by the Wights...
choice_prompt:12:1210613008.source_cn: ……也是，他还有什么能用来交换呢？我们穷成这样，连面包都吃不上……还总是被水鬼骚扰。

say:13:1210613009:1.text: Yeah! If you go back to Rustport, you will all be under the protection of the Carmine Whispers. The Water Wights can't bug you there!
say:13:1210613009:1.source_cn: 对呀，城里有血薇帮，有他们在，水鬼都会被抓起来的！

say:14:1210613010:1.text: They would never welcome us back after we left on our own.
say:14:1210613010:1.source_cn: 那里不欢迎我们，我们就是从城里搬出来的。

say:16:1210613014:1.text: Our husbands were sailors, and Sinbad's father was their captain. They set sail to find a legendary treasure for Tesio and never returned.

say:17:1210613015:1.text: It's quite tragic, but in Rustport, stories of people dying at sea is common.
say:17:1210613015:1.source_cn: 说来悲惨，但在锈锚港，死在海里的故事，也很常见。

say:20:1210613017:1.source_cn: 不是死潮舰队干的，你们误会了。

say:21:1210613018:1.text: In these waters, there are always legendary tales of human conflicts. Did you know? Rustport used to be infested with pirates until the Carmine Whispers drove them away.
say:21:1210613018:1.source_cn: 这片海域，从来只有人类和人类争斗的传奇故事。你们还不知...

say:22:1210613019:1.text: When the Dead Tide Fleet appeared, we finally saw what Graveborn looked like.
say:22:1210613019:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队出现后，我们才知道亡灵长什么样子。

say:23:1210613020:1.text: We joked that the pirates driven away by the Whispers were so unwilling to give up on Rustport that they came back as Graveborn.
say:23:1210613020:1.source_cn: 我们也打趣，难道是被血薇帮打跑的海盗贼心不死，化身亡灵...

say:27:1210613023:1.source_cn: 他向来信任泰西欧，再加上泰西欧说会让另一支船队迎击海盗...

say:29:1210613025:1.text: As widows of these so-called cowards, everyone in Rustport scorned us. We couldn't bear it any longer, so we moved away.

say:31:1210613026:1.text: Yes, sort of. All the women here came together to raise him. But though we found a place to settle down, we're still not at peace because of the frequent trouble from the Water Wights...

say:32:1210613027:1.text: That's so sad... I've got tears in my eyes.

say:35:1210613030:1.text: Alright, alright! Next time you guys visit, I promise we'll have a warmer welcome for you.
